description: Migrate all eligible users from the source environment to the target environment using the bulk endpoint.

emit.description: Optional callback invoked with structured progress events. If not provided, the method emits no events and only returns a final result. Event payloads follow a consistent shape: - ``type``: str ("started" | "progress" | "warning" | "error" | "completed") - ``step``: str logical step identifier - ``message``: str human-readable message - Additional fields depending on the step (counts, status_code, etc.)

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all users from the source environment to the target environment and track the progress?

emit.message: Fetching users from the source environment

examples.notes: This call migrates all eligible users from the source environment to the target environment and uses the 'emit' callback to track progress at each step.

examples.user_query: I need to migrate users but don't want to handle progress events. How can I do that?
examples.notes: This call migrates all eligible users without emitting progress events. Use this when you only need the final result.

examples.user_query: Can I monitor warnings and errors during the user migration process?

emit.message: Some roles could not be mapped to the target environment

examples.notes: This call migrates users and uses the 'emit' callback to capture warnings and errors, such as unmapped roles or groups.
